derivar.subtitulo: After {{dias}} days in a row, a habit is yours. Each one keeps its own streak.

vista.reglasCumplidas: You kept them all today. The system takes note.
vista.reglasPendientes: Anything left unchecked at the close counts as broken: {{xp}} XP per rule and its consequence tomorrow.
vista.vacioCuerpo: Reading, running, cold calls, going to bed on time. Whatever you want to come naturally one day.
vista.nadaEnForja: Nothing in the forge right now. What's already yours is below.
vista.adquiridoDetalle: No longer asked of you. Long-press to require it again.
vista.adquiridoA11y: {{titulo}}, acquired. Long-press to require it again.
vista.adquiridoDiasA11y: {{titulo}}, acquired after {{dias}} days. Long-press to require it again.

hook.adquiridoMensaje:
{{titulo}} has gone {{dias}} days in a row.

If you mark it as acquired, it stops asking for the daily check and can no longer break your streak. You can keep checking it whenever you want.

If you'd rather keep counting, that's fine: it keeps adding up.
hook.esTuyoPagado:
{{titulo}} won't be asked of you anymore.
+{{xp}} XP to {{stat}}.
hook.esTuyoSinPago:
{{titulo}} won't be asked of you anymore.
This reward doesn't count today: it was already paid or you've hit the daily cap.
hook.volverAExigirloMensaje: {{titulo}} is required every day again and counts toward the streak again.
